table.name: TLGNC_TRUCK_UNAVAILABILITY
table.description: Stores timeperiods when a certain truck is not available.

column.name: TRUCK_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_truck. Truck ID, to which this record is related to.

column.name: START_DAT
column.description: The start date/time from when truck is unavailable.

column.name: END_DAT
column.description: The end date/time until when a truck is unavailable. In case it's open end, a hardcoded date of 31.12.9999=infinite is set.

column.name: DESCRIPTION
column.description: Description, event, cause of the absence.
